_documentation.purpose: Sweep stationary optical-hotspot offset, absorbed power, and optional beam width while comparing opposed +offset/-offset controls from one shared dark-prepared vortex state.
_documentation.relies_on: Builds configs/simulations/nbn_optical_vortex_unpinned.json for geometry, material, timestep, TDGL, and thermal coefficients.
_documentation.authority: This file sets sweep axes, field, seed, and time budget; the referenced simulation supplies material and numerical settings. The sweep runner overrides laser settings and zeroes applied current.
_documentation.sweep_metric: mean_motion_toward_beam_nm is the average dark-subtracted vortex displacement projected toward the +offset and -offset beam positions. Positive means attraction toward the hotspot.
_documentation.sweeps.beam_offsets_m: List of [dx_m, dy_m] vectors. Each vector is one beam-vortex separation and is tested in both + and - directions.
_documentation.sweeps.absorbed_powers_W: List of absorbed powers. Each becomes a separate line in the distance-versus-offset plot for a fixed spot width.
_documentation.sweeps.spot_sigmas_m: List of Gaussian sigma values. One distance-versus-offset plot is saved per sigma, plus width-comparison plots when multiple sigmas are supplied.

fields.simulation_config: Base simulation JSON providing the material, film, thermal dynamics, and solver settings.
fields.applied_field_T: Uniform perpendicular applied magnetic field in tesla.
fields.initial_vortex.x_fraction: Initial vortex x location divided by film width.
fields.initial_vortex.y_fraction: Initial vortex y location divided by film height.
fields.initial_vortex.core_radius_cells: Initial vortex-core radius in mesh cells.
fields.seed_position_m: Seeded vortex physical coordinates in metres used to position the beams.
fields.sweeps.beam_offsets_m: Offset vectors in metres; each is tested with both signs.
fields.sweeps.absorbed_powers_W: Absorbed film powers in watts, independent of incident optical power.
fields.sweeps.spot_sigmas_m: Gaussian standard deviations of the optical spot in metres.
fields.minimum_directional_response_nm: Minimum dark-subtracted motion toward both mirrored beams required to flag a response, in nanometres.
fields.timing.dark_steps: No-laser equilibration steps shared by every case.
fields.timing.exposure_steps: Time steps for each illuminated and dark control branch.
fields.timing.sample_every: Steps between saved gradient and vortex-position diagnostics.
fields.output_directory: Base result directory; a numbered sibling is reserved for each new run.
